scope: Read-only design review; no workloads or product edits.
preferred_design: An auxiliary identity transaction lease with state-lock handoff and generation revalidation, rather than introducing lock-free journal/state identity discovery for this release.
rationale: Preserves existing full foreign capsule domain/event validation and journal recovery rather than narrowing _find to extension-only snapshots.
A lease held across duplicate check and persistence can serialize check/write semantics; a lock-free snapshot does not by itself make multi-capsule uniqueness transactional.
Provider execution occurs after the initial provider UoW closes, so the auxiliary lease need not cover external model execution.
required_handoff_invariants: Before first acquisition, release every currently held capsule state lock; retaining any state lock while waiting on the auxiliary lease can recreate an opposing wait.
Retain staged cached aggregates and reacquire their previous update locks in deterministic order only after acquiring the lease.

For every persisted aggregate whose update lock was released, recover and validate disk generation under the reacquired state lock before continuing. Any change aborts with ConflictError: do not continue old authorization or staged writes.
New/reserved capsules have no persisted generation; handle this case explicitly and reject unexpected competing persisted state instead of treating missing state as a normal existing capsule.
Retain the auxiliary identity lease across all identity checks and commit, and until rollback/close releases it; release state locks before dropping the auxiliary lease.
Acquisition timeout, failed reacquisition, stale generation and commit failure require deterministic cleanup of every partially acquired lease; do not automatically retry a partly staged transaction.
Owner-known provider/tool reads must use scoped canonical owner loads and avoid this lease/global discovery in the normal path.

memory_ordering.production_inventory: No uow.memory/lease.memory usage in reviewed production auxiliary call paths (agents/service, core/executor/external/recovery, execution and delivery). Memory service acquires source projection independently.
memory_ordering.concrete_generic_hazard: UoW A holds memory source-projection write lease then waits for auxiliary lease; UoW B holds auxiliary lease then first accesses/locks memory. Releasing only state locks does not break this inversion.
memory_ordering.required_bound: Explicitly enforce a lock order or reject auxiliary lease acquisition while a foreign-order retained memory write lease exists. Merely documenting that current services do not mix these phases is not a general mixed-UoW safety guarantee.

nested_same_thread_ownership.issue: FileLock is thread-reentrant; distinct nested UoWs in the same thread may both acquire one logical auxiliary lease. A bare FileLock does not establish distinct transaction ownership for uncommitted cross-UoW identity intents.
references: task_store.py:518-522 controller lease owner token precedents
nested_same_thread_ownership.required_bound: Either enforce auxiliary lease transaction ownership as existing controller ownership does, or explicitly restrict/reject nested identity-writing UoWs. Validate behavior with a meaningful nested-UoW test.

journal_properties: task_store.py:1285-1295 atomically writes immutable encoded/checksummed prepared documents.
task_store.py:548-555 installs execution/state.yaml last among documents; events follow at :556-590; marker removal occurs at :591-592.
State alone can lag an already durable prepared identity during recovery; marker disappearance must cause a canonical-state re-read rather than returning an earlier state.
requirements: Validate marker schema/generation, complete documents dictionary, every path and document checksum, decoded canonical state envelope, run/capsule identity and requested extension ownership/duplicate constraints.
Reject malformed markers rather than silently falling back to state; distinguish a genuine disappearance race from invalid content.
Use a bounded consistency read/recheck loop for journal replacement/removal and state generation, failing with explicit conflict on exhaustion.
Handle new prepared capsules without state and discovery index races.
Do not combine independently sampled state and events into a false coherent full snapshot.
A snapshot identity scan is not a global check-through-commit uniqueness lock.
lock_free_alternative_review.semantic_cost: Current _find validates all unrelated canonical domain models and complete event history via load_capsule. Extension-only snapshots narrow those validations unless separately preserved; this must be deliberate and tested, not described as unchanged full validation.

focused_validation_needed: Real two-run held-own-lock cached provider read and write-side duplicate check: no opposing 10 second wait, with preserved before/after records.
State generation changes during handoff: original staged writes/events must not persist and old authorization must not be reused.
Cross-run duplicate IDs, same-run idempotency conflicts, corrupted foreign capsule event/domain state, prepared journal recovery, rollback and partial-acquisition cleanup.
Memory-first mixed UoW and nested same-thread UoW ordering must fail promptly or complete according to explicitly enforced ownership; no timeout masking.
Fresh source freeze and full qualification follow an implemented repair; this design review does not clear the P1 by itself.
